import openpyxl, os
p=os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p)
ws=wb.active
vals=[ws.cell(row=r,column=8).value for r in range(2,19)]
vals=[v for v in vals if v is not None]
uniq=sorted(set(vals))
for i,v in enumerate(uniq):
    ws.cell(row=2,column=17+i).value=v
wb.save(p)
print(uniq)
